title.en: An Act Authorizing the Payment of a Special Remuneration to Frank W. Carpenter, Governor of the Department of Mindanao and Sulu.

text.en:
The Secretary of the Interior is hereby authorized to pay, out of any items of expense
appropriated for the Bureau of Non-Christian Tribes by Act Numbered Twenty-eight hundred and
seventy-five, the sum of fifty thousand pesos to Frank W. Carpenter, Governor of the Department of
Mindanao and Sulu, in recognition of the extraordinary services rendered by him to the Government of the
Philippine Islands. This special remuneration shall be paid without prejudice to any priveleges or rights
granted by existing law.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 24, 1920.
